text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
RZECZPOSPOLITA

- Poland caught 147,273 tonnes of fish from the Baltic Sea last year, which showed an 11 percent increase from 1995, the Maritime Fishing Institute said. In 1997 the Baltic Commission allowed Poland the following fishing quotas: 112,273 tonnes of herring, 145,200 tonnes of sprat, 38,000 tonnes of cod, and 25,284 heads of salmon.
- Foreign companies invested over $11 billion in Poland by end-1996, unofficial data from the Polish Foreign Investment Agency (PAIZ) said.
American and German concerns were the biggest investors.
- Over 180 food processing firms are exhibiting their products at a three-day food-product fair organised in Warsaw by the Agrotechnika food processing firm.
- The production capacity of the Gorzow-based WPPZM pasta maker, recently taken over by the PZZ Lublin grain processing firm, will reach 70 tonnes per day, PZZ Lublin said.

- The Centertel analogue mobile telephone firm will slash connection prices by about 40 percent as of tomorrow, the company said. Hitherto Centertel had been limiting its cuts to installation and equipment prices.
- Poland's export revenues last year exceeded 1995 results by eight percent, while the value of imports grew by 26 percent, economy ministry preliminary data said.
NOWA EUROPA

- Poland's Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz ordered the Supreme Auditing Chamber (NIK) to check state-owned bank PKO BP's new computer system and its changing of its account numbers. Cimoszewicz suspects that the bank may have infringed customer rights.
- Polish-Romanian trade turnover in 1996 was over $100 million, Poland's foreign trade ministry said.
- The Era GSM and Plus GSM digital mobile phone networks have contracted around 100,000 customers since their start in last year's second half.
Era GSM currently boasts over 40,000 customers, Era's spokesperson Robert Niczewski said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
Poland's current account deficit reached $12 billion last year. Food imports accounted for $1.0 billion of the deficit, the Farming Assistance Programme Foundation (FAPA) said.
ZYCIE

- The British Standards Institution (BSI) has awarded the listed ComputerLand computer firm an Interantional Standards Organisation (ISO)-9001 certificate for its computer integration systems quality.
- Poland's poultry consumption last year reached 417,000 tonnes, showing eight percent growth from 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
